# Isaiah Chapter 36 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 22 verses]*

*Rabshakeh's speech; taunts against God; Hezekiah told not to trust Egypt; people silent*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 36 (Sennacherib's Invasion) addresses rabshakeh's speech; taunts against god; hezekiah told not to trust egypt; people silent. The key verse — "Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to deliver you" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to First Isaiah (chs. 1-39), focused on judgment and the Assyrian crisis.
